51132419.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human GlyRalpha3cryst by SPR method

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: SPR experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The human GlyRα3cryst protein was immobilized on the chip surface via amine coupling. The running buffer was HBS-EP+ (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4). Compounds were diluted in running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase was 120 seconds, followed by a 120-second dissociation phase. The chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 seconds. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding affinity (KD) was determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Overlay of modeled local minimum conformations of leads 1 (blue) and 19 (pink). Images generated using PyMOL Molecular Graphics System, Version 1.8 Schrödinger, LLC. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
